import math


class ParallelStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
        self.Settings.DailyPreciseEndTime = True

        tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily, Market.USA, False
            ).Symbol
            for ticker in tickers
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        self.spy_previous_pair = None

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
            14, MovingAverageType.Wilders
        )
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_samples = 0

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(21, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_today_pair = None

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                spy_today_pair = (
                    spy_close,
                    float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
                )

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
            self.aapl_samples += 1

        all_bars_present = all(
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol)
            for symbol in self.symbols.values()
        )

        fully_formed = (
            spy_today_pair is not None
            and self.spy_previous_pair is not None
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_samples >= 4
        )

        if self.IsWarmingUp or not all_bars_present or not fully_formed:
            if spy_today_pair is not None:
                self.spy_previous_pair = spy_today_pair
            return

        self.spy_lot = max(0, int(self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity))
        self.aapl_lot = max(0, int(self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity))

        previous_spy_close, previous_spy_sma = self.spy_previous_pair
        current_spy_close, current_spy_sma = spy_today_pair

        spy_crossed_above = (
            previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if (
            self.aapl_lot > 0
            and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            spy_quantity = int(
                math.floor(
                    0.40
                    * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                    / current_spy_close
                )
            )
            if spy_quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, spy_quantity)
                self.spy_lot = spy_quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000:
                aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
                aapl_quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / aapl_close))
                if aapl_quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, aapl_quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = aapl_quantity

        self.spy_previous_pair = spy_today_pair

            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None

from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig
        ]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
            14, MovingAverageType.Wilders
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.spy_lot_open = False
        self.aapl_lot_open = False

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_crossed_above = False
        spy_crossed_below = False

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            spy_close = spy_bar.Close

            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
            spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
            spy_sma_value = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            if (
                spy_sma_ready
                and self.previous_spy_sma_ready
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            ):
                spy_crossed_above = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > spy_sma_value
                )
                spy_crossed_below = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < spy_sma_value
                )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma_value
            self.previous_spy_sma_ready = spy_sma_ready

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_sma_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
        ):
            return

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.spy_lot_open and spy_crossed_below:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.spy_lot_open = False

        if self.aapl_lot_open and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.Liquidate(self.aapl)
            self.aapl_lot_open = False

        if not self.spy_lot_open and spy_crossed_above:
            self.SetHoldings(self.spy, 0.40)
            self.spy_lot_open = True

        if not self.aapl_lot_open and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
                quantity = math.floor(20_000 / float(aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot_open = True
